units.source_text: 我什么都不想隐瞒，

en.t: I do not want to hide anything,

units.source_text: 但是，如果这里面存在着我所不知道的隐情，

en.t: but if there are hidden circumstances here that I do not know about,

units.source_text: 那么无论我怎样回答，也不会令她满意的，

en.t: then no matter how I answered, it would not satisfy her,

units.source_text: 而且我确信这里面有着我所不知道的情况。

en.t: and I was certain that there was something here that I did not know.

units.source_text: “我不知道。”我回答。

en.t: "I do not know," I answered.

units.source_text: 一瞬间，只见夫人脸上露出了期待落空时的可怜表情。

en.t: For an instant, Sensei's wife showed a pitiful expression, like someone whose hopes had been disappointed.

units.source_text: 我赶紧补上一句话：

en.t: I hurriedly added another sentence:

units.source_text: “但是我可以保证先生没有厌弃夫人，

en.t: "But I can assure you that Sensei has not come to dislike you,

units.source_text: 我只是如实地把先生亲口说的话传达给您，

en.t: I am only telling you exactly what Sensei said with his own mouth,

units.source_text: 先生不是个说谎的人吧。”

en.t: and Sensei is not a man who lies, is he?"

units.source_text: 夫人什么也没有回答，

en.t: Sensei's wife gave no answer,

units.source_text: 过了会儿说：“其实我也猜到了一点儿，不过……”

en.t: and after a while she said, "To tell the truth, I have guessed a little of it too, but..."

units.source_text: “是关于先生变成现在这样子的原因吗？”

en.t: "Is it about the reason Sensei became the way he is now?"

units.source_text: “是的，如果真是那个原因的话，

en.t: "Yes. If that really is the reason,

units.source_text: 就没有我的责任了，

en.t: then I would bear no responsibility,

units.source_text: 所以只要弄明白这一点，我就可以解脱了……”

en.t: so if only I could make that clear, I would be able to feel relieved..."

units.source_text: “怎么回事？”

en.t: "What happened?"

units.source_text: 夫人顿了顿，凝视着放在膝上的自己的手，

en.t: Sensei's wife hesitated, gazing at her own hands resting on her knees,

units.source_text: 说：“我说，你来判断吧。”

en.t: and said, "I will tell you, and you judge it."

units.source_text: “只要是我能判断的。”

en.t: "If it is something I can judge."

units.source_text: “可是不能全说，

en.t: "But I cannot say everything,

units.source_text: 全说了要挨骂的，

en.t: if I said everything, I would be scolded,

units.source_text: 只能说不会挨骂的内容。”

en.t: so I can only tell you the parts I would not be scolded for."

units.source_text: 我紧张得咽了口唾沫。

en.t: I was so tense that I swallowed hard.

units.source_text: “那还是先生上大学的时候，

en.t: "That was back when Sensei was still at university,

units.source_text: 他有个非常要好的朋友。

en.t: he had a very close friend.

units.source_text: 那个朋友在临近毕业时死了，

en.t: That friend died when graduation was drawing near,

units.source_text: 死得很突然。”

en.t: and his death was very sudden."

units.source_text: 夫人对着我的耳朵小声说：“其实是自杀。”

en.t: Sensei's wife whispered into my ear, "In fact, it was suicide."

units.source_text: 听她这么说，我不能不反问一句：“为什么？”

en.t: Hearing her say that, I could not help asking back, "Why?"
